channelTitle: The one-ingredient hiccup fix that's been passed down forever
hook: Hiccups hit in the middle of dinner, and Grandma June doesn't tell you to hold your breath, she hands you a spoon instead.
remedy: Swallowing a dry teaspoon of plain sugar is one of the oldest, simplest home remedies for a stubborn case of hiccups, believed to work by interrupting the nerve signals causing the spasm.
steps: Measure out a level teaspoon of plain white sugar
Swallow it dry, without water, in one go
Wait a minute to see if the hiccups stop before trying again
caution: Not recommended for very young children due to choking risk - use a safer method for kids. See a doctor if hiccups last more than two days.
cta: Has the sugar trick ever actually worked for you? Tell Grandma June your hiccup fix.
